destination.title: Anomalies, global structures and consistency of field theories
destination.question: How do anomalies and related global, geometric or defect consistency tests constrain specified field theories, their observables and proposed ultraviolet realizations?
destination.summary: A navigational family spanning ordinary field theory, supergravity and string constructions. Local cancellation, global consistency, anomaly matching, geometric realization and probe tests remain distinct targets.

systems: String compactifications, branes and charged strings
Conformal theories, topological phases and Standard Model extensions
targets: Global gauge forms, admissible backgrounds and charge data
regimes: Source-specified dimensions, supersymmetry and matter content
Perturbative, global and nonperturbative questions kept distinct
assumptions: Anomaly cancellation is not treated as sufficient for a fixed point or quantum-gravity completion
Probe existence, charge admissibility and completeness assumptions are source-specific
Absence of a known string construction is not itself an inconsistency result
conventions: Gauge algebra, global gauge group and combined spacetime/internal structure are distinct data
Gauged anomalies require cancellation; background anomalies can instead require matching
Source-relative claims retain their supplied dates
includes: Positive consistency evidence as well as exclusions
Boundary questions about global observables and geometric realization
excludes: Anomalous scaling dimensions included solely because of the word anomalous
Universal completeness or uniqueness claims inferred from selected examples
Automatic promotion of source-object relations to physical premises

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Can realistic anomaly-free brane sectors be built without destabilizing closed fields needed for anomaly-canceling axions? Can explicit geometries, twisted-sector alternatives, or brane networks realize the effective constructions?

sources.title: String universality in ten dimensions

evidence.text: Can ten-dimensional N=1 supergravity with gauge group U(1)^496 or E8 × U(1)^248 simultaneously satisfy supersymmetry, abelian gauge invariance and gravitational anomaly cancellation, closing the remaining apparent exceptions to ten-dimensional string universality?

sources.title: D=7 / D=6 Heterotic Supergravity with Gauged R-Symmetry

evidence.text: Can a D=7/D=6 Hořava–Witten construction retain gauged R-symmetry and a positive scalar potential while canceling boundary gravitational, gauge, mixed and local-supersymmetry anomalies?

sources.title: Anomalies and Invertible Field Theories

evidence.text: How can lagrangian and hamiltonian anomalies be organized as one local invertible field theory, and how do spin structures cancel or simplify the anomaly of minimally supersymmetric quantum mechanics?

sources.title: Adler-Bardeen theorem and cancellation of gauge anomalies to all orders in nonrenormalizable theories

evidence.text: Under what assumptions does triviality of one-loop gauge anomalies ensure their cancellation at every perturbative order in nonrenormalizable gauge theories, and how explicitly can the required subtraction scheme be specified?

sources.title: An Analysis of Anomaly Cancellation for Theories in D=10

evidence.text: Which gauge algebras can cancel local anomalies when ten-dimensional N=1 supergravity, containing one two-form, is coupled to adjoint N=1 super Yang–Mills?

sources.title: Fermion Path Integrals And Topological Phases

evidence.text: How do anomalies of fermion path integrals and bulk anomaly inflow describe free-fermion topological insulators and superconductors, including on unorientable spacetime, and what precisely does electromagnetic θ = π mean in a three-dimensional topological insulator?

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in 6D F-theory models and tuned elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: The (−3,−2) cluster tests whether the g2 algebra on its −3 curve can be enhanced while retaining the neighboring type III su(2). Its four leading coefficient parameters provide a concrete comparison between anomaly counting and local geometry.

sources.title: Enhanced gauge symmetry in 6D F-theory models and tuned elliptic Calabi-Yau threefolds

evidence.text: The two neighboring su(2) factors constrain enhancement of the central −3 curve. The local geometry supplies only one f_2 coefficient and no g_3 coefficient, while anomaly analysis supplies a proposed so(8) spectrum to compare with the geometric test.

sources.title: Theta, Time Reversal, and Temperature

evidence.text: How do θ periodicity and mixed CP/time-reversal–center anomalies constrain Yang–Mills vacua, domain walls, and thermal transitions, especially for SU(2) near θ=π?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: What constraints remain beyond the local anomaly polynomial? The source lists global gauge-anomaly congruences from π6(G), then identifies anomalies of discrete global symmetries as a separate unresolved problem.

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: The entries specify anomaly data for conformal matter with different left and right endpoint groups. The background fields distinguish R-symmetry, gravitational, individual flavor, and mixed flavor contributions.

sources.title: Large U(1) charges in F-theory

evidence.text: Can positivity or additional quantum consistency constrain abelian anomaly coefficients and primitive charges? The explicit coefficient 744S̃ must remain allowed by any compatible bound.

sources.title: A New SU(2) Anomaly

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional SU(2) theories that avoid the familiar anomaly nevertheless become anomalous when formulated using a spin-SU(2) structure without choosing a spin structure?

sources.title: An Anomaly-free Atlas: charting the space of flavour-dependent gauged $U(1)$ extensions of the Standard Model

evidence.text: Which rational, family-dependent U(1)F charge assignments cancel all gauge and mixed gauge-gravity anomalies for SM fermions, optionally supplemented by up to three right-handed neutrinos, and how can these assignments be classified and enumerated?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a supergravity theory that passes bulk anomaly cancellation nevertheless fail because its required charged strings cannot support unitary worldsheet degrees of freedom?

sources.title: Swampland Bounds on the Abelian Gauge Sector

evidence.text: Which geometric information verifies the probe-string assumptions and strengthens the supergravity bound on section-derived abelian gauge factors?

sources.title: Notes on anomalies, elliptic curves and the BS-D conjecture

evidence.text: When do anomaly cancellation and compact U(1) leave finitely many rational hypercharge assignments in generalized SU(N) × SU(2) × U(1) models? The principal case has left-handed quarks and leptons in SU(2) triplets.

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: How should an anomaly classification be used differently for an ungauged matter system and a dynamical gauge theory?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: How does the Z6 Standard Model group embed in SU(5), and how does its determinant constraint alter the characteristic-class input relative to independent unitary bundles?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: When does the fermionic Z4 extension impose global anomaly matching, and when is it part of a dynamical gauge group whose anomaly must cancel?

sources.title: The UV fate of anomalous U(1)s and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a cubic-anomalous spectrum be completed with few heavy species while supporting a large vector-to-cutoff hierarchy? The first construction ignores gravity and allows noninteger charges.

sources.title: The UV fate of anomalous U(1)s and the Swampland

evidence.text: Do analogous restrictions survive higher-dimensional cancellation mechanisms, and how strongly do the four-dimensional bounds constrain massive-vector models with heavy chiral anomaly cancellers?

sources.title: Swampland Constraints on 5d $\mathcal{N}=1$ Supergravity

evidence.text: This compact example tests the proposed string conditions in a U(1)×SU(2) theory with nine fundamental hypermultiplets. Its magnetic charges are nonnegative integer combinations of H and H−E.

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of heterotic strings on $T^d$

evidence.text: Can another eight-dimensional construction with 16 supercharges realize E8+D7+A3, and could global anomalies explain why this algebra is excluded in toroidal heterotic compactification?

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: What restrictions follow from anomaly inflow onto strings coupled to four-dimensional tensor fields, or their dual axions, in minimally supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric theories?

sources.title: String Universality and Non-Simply-Connected Gauge Groups in 8d

evidence.text: Do restrictions on non-simply-connected gauge groups G/Z in 8d string compactifications follow from quantum-gravity consistency, and how much of the apparent Swampland can a center-symmetry anomaly exclude?

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Can one low-energy principle identify theories excluded by forced extra gauge factors, invalid geometric tunings and extra rational sections? The obstacle is that anomaly and string-charge data specify a homology class without visibly specifying the distinguished gauge-supporting curve.

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: What excludes the infinite anomaly-compatible su(N)⊕u(1) families, including N<13 descendants for which the specific su(13) local enhancement does not apply? The source leaves both the common obstruction and the role of quadratic charge dependence unresolved.

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: Can the anomaly-compatible T=0 su(2) spectrum with two half-hypermultiplets in the 4 representation be realized geometrically? The proposed realization requires a degree-five curve on P² with two distinct triple points.

sources.title: Low Energy Supersymmetry from Non-Geometry

evidence.text: Combine a world-volume-flux D-term with non-perturbative stabilization, then minimize over charged open fields. A viable uplift requires a surviving positive contribution at the small vacuum-energy scale rather than automatic D-flatness or a Planck-scale energy.

sources.title: String universality in ten dimensions

evidence.text: Compare the four-form factor Y4 of the anomaly polynomial with dH3, where supersymmetry and gauge invariance require Chern–Simons modifications of the B2 field strength. The paper identifies their agreement as essential to Green–Schwarz cancellation.

sources.title: D=7 / D=6 Heterotic Supergravity with Gauged R-Symmetry

evidence.text: Use bosonic and fermionic Gibbons–Hawking–York terms, supersymmetry orbits of modified boundary conditions, Israel junction conditions and Noether coupling to match boundary actions with bulk surface variations.

sources.title: Anomalies and Invertible Field Theories

evidence.text: The topological anomaly models are specified by spectrum maps: the even-oriented model uses w₂(X) and a mod-2 Thom map; the general-target model uses spin bordism, [TX] in ko-theory, the spin Thom isomorphism, and the maps θ and γ.

sources.title: Adler-Bardeen theorem and cancellation of gauge anomalies to all orders in nonrenormalizable theories

evidence.text: Batalin–Vilkovisky formalism tracks gauge invariance through the master equation. The anomaly functional is A=(Γ,Γ)=〈(S,S)〉; the antibracket Jacobi identity supplies Wess–Zumino consistency.

sources.title: An Analysis of Anomaly Cancellation for Theories in D=10

evidence.text: List allowed factor terms, expand their product, solve coefficients fixed by distinctive monomials and test the residual equations. A contradiction identifies the curvature terms carrying the obstruction.

sources.title: Quantum gravity bounds on $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 effective theories in four dimensions

evidence.text: What constraints on four-dimensional N=1 gauge-gravity EFTs follow from consistency of axionic EFT-string worldsheets, beyond bulk anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: Anomalies and discrete torsion in Type II and Type I worldsheet theories

evidence.text: Which target-space topology cancels Type II and Type I worldsheet anomalies, and what physical choices are encoded by the remaining discrete torsion?

sources.title: Dai-Freed anomalies in particle physics

evidence.text: Does requiring an unambiguous fermion partition-function phase on arbitrary allowed manifolds and gauge bundles impose constraints beyond traditional local and global anomalies, particularly for the Standard Model, GUTs and discrete symmetries?

sources.title: Uniqueness of D=8 minimal supergravity with two vector multiplets

evidence.text: Do anomaly cancellation, gauge-enhancement singularities and higher-dimensional limits uniquely constrain the BPS protected couplings of eight-dimensional minimal supergravity with two vector multiplets, and exclude a gravitational contribution to the H-flux Bianchi identity?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: Which constraints distinguish anomaly-free EFTs admitting quantum-gravity UV completions from the Swampland, how are these constraints connected, and how are they realized in string compactifications?

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: When can a circle-reduced anomaly be expressed through characteristic classes rather than a general nonlocal eta invariant?

sources.title: Anomaly free gauged R symmetry in local supersymmetry

evidence.text: Can a gauged R-symmetry provide an anomaly-free supergravity extension of the supersymmetric Standard Model, with viable symmetry breaking and restrictions on baryon- and lepton-number violation?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can a family with arbitrarily many tensors and E8 gauge factors pass the string-probe test for a specified anomaly-lattice realization?

sources.title: Exploring new constraints on Kähler moduli space of 6d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 supergravity

evidence.text: Can positivity and boundary consistency of five-dimensional Coulomb branches constrain anomaly-free six-dimensional supergravity beyond anomaly cancellation, particularly by fixing gauge-group global forms and required BPS-string excitations?

sources.title: CPT and other symmetries in string / M theory

evidence.text: Can discrete instanton anomalies reveal nonperturbative consistency conditions on string vacua, and does classical spacetime CPT survive in available nonperturbative descriptions of M-theory?

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: Can an anomalous symmetry of a proposed parent obstruct lifting when that symmetry may emerge only after compactification? Can infrared-dual three-dimensional UV descriptions differ in liftability, or can supersymmetry central extensions supply an obstruction?

sources.title: Topological Modular Forms and the Absence of All Heterotic Global Anomalies

evidence.text: Do gravitational, gauge and mixed global anomalies cancel in arbitrary perturbative heterotic compactifications, including those described by internal SCFTs without a smooth geometric interpretation?

sources.title: Anomalies in string-inspired nonlocal extensions of QED

evidence.text: How do vector and axial anomalies, their Noether currents and the local limit behave in an exponential infinite-derivative extension of QED, and what illustrative constraint follows from π⁰→γγ?

sources.title: Anomalies, Black strings and the charged Cardy formula

evidence.text: How do internal-manifold isometries contribute to anomalies and current levels after twisted compactification, and can these levels explain the entropy of electrically charged, rotating supersymmetric AdS black strings through the charged Cardy formula?

sources.title: Automatic enhancement in 6D supergravity and F-theory models

evidence.text: When does a gauge group and anomaly-compatible matter spectrum require additional gauged symmetry in a quantum-gravity construction? The proposed criterion compares the desired theory with a containing theory whose additional symmetry cannot be removed by a supersymmetric Higgs deformation.

sources.title: Anomalies in field theories with extra dimensions

evidence.text: How are gauge and gravitational anomalies computed and canceled in higher-dimensional effective theories, especially when orbifold singularities and discrete Wilson lines produce localized anomalies?

sources.title: Consistency of eight-dimensional supergravities: anomalies, lattices and counterterms

evidence.text: Which eight-dimensional minimal supergravities admit local counterterms cancelling their composite U(1), and hence discrete modular, anomalies, once counterterm singularities must correspond to gauge enhancement?

sources.title: Modified Abelian gauge theories

evidence.text: How can constraints on characteristic classes define global variants of Abelian gauge theories, and how do these constraints change conserved charges and potential anomalies?

sources.title: The anomaly that was not meant IIB

evidence.text: Does the full discrete type IIB duality group have quantum anomalies obstructing its gauging, and can suitable topological couplings restore consistency with F-theory? Could alternative cancellation mechanisms define theories with the same massless supergravity fields?

sources.title: A Note on the Green-Schwarz mechanism in open string theories

evidence.text: How can several antisymmetric tensors jointly implement Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation in lower-dimensional open-string models whose residual anomaly polynomial does not admit the conventional single-tensor factorization, and what low-energy supergravity couplings realize this structure?

sources.title: The Global Anomaly of the Self-Dual Field in General Backgrounds

evidence.text: How do flat background Wilson lines and torsion fluxes modify the self-dual field’s global anomaly, and how do anomaly holonomies determine its physical theta characteristic?

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: How do six-dimensional bulk anomaly coefficients determine the anomalies of strings charged under self-dual tensor fields?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: Which combined spacetime and internal symmetry structure should constrain anomalies? Identifying fermion parity with an internal central element changes the admissible backgrounds and can change the anomaly classification.

sources.title: 8d gauge anomalies and the topological Green-Schwarz mechanism

evidence.text: Which eight-dimensional N=1 gauge theories have global gauge anomalies, and which anomalies can be canceled by coupling to topological degrees of freedom? The motivating cases are odd orthogonal groups, F4, G2 and the string-realized Sp(N) theories.

sources.title: Ultra Unification

evidence.text: Can the discrete-X mixed gauge-gravitational anomaly of the 15-Weyl-fermion SM or SU(5) GUT be canceled using topological or gapless hidden sectors, possibly together with sterile neutrinos?

sources.title: More on supersymmetric domain walls, N counting and glued potentials

evidence.text: How can field theory explain linear-in-N wall tension and confining strings ending on walls? Can glued low-energy potentials determine wall tensions or BPS saturation, and does discrete anomaly matching exclude a chirally symmetric vacuum of supersymmetric gluodynamics?

sources.title: Note on discrete gauge anomalies

evidence.text: Which discrete anomaly constraints follow intrinsically from low-energy physics, which depend on a high-energy embedding, and how are apparent discrete anomalies accommodated in perturbatively consistent string models?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can string unitarity exclude anomaly-allowed SU(N) theories with symmetric matter even though the source reports no F-theory realization?

sources.title: Anomaly cancellation in supergravity with Fayet-Iliopoulos couplings

evidence.text: Which gauge and mixed gravitational anomaly cancellation conditions remain physically necessary in supergravity with Fayet–Iliopoulos couplings after allowing finite local counterterms, and what does Green–Schwarz cancellation change?

sources.title: Cobordism Conjecture, Anomalies, and the String Lamppost Principle

evidence.text: Can cobordism triviality and lower-dimensional anomaly cancellation explain gaps in gauge-group ranks, constrain global gauge forms, and support the String Lamppost Principle for theories with sixteen supercharges?

sources.title: Cobordism and deformation class of the standard model

evidence.text: Which symmetry and five-dimensional anomaly-inflow data specify the proposed deformation class of the four-dimensional Standard Model, with its internal group either ungauged or gauged and with continuous or discrete B−L-like symmetry?

sources.title: Anomaly constraints for heterotic strings and supergravity in six dimensions

evidence.text: Does cancellation of Dai-Freed anomalies impose additional consistency conditions on six-dimensional gravitational EFTs that pass local anomaly and charge-lattice constraints, particularly families with unbounded abelian charges?

sources.title: What Bordism-Theoretic Anomaly Cancellation Can Do for U

evidence.text: Can four-dimensional N=8 supergravity with continuous E7(7)(R) U-duality have a nonperturbative anomaly invisible to its anomaly polynomial, and does its actual field content realize or cancel that possibility?

sources.title: Branes and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the anomaly-free SU(N) × SU(N) family permit arbitrarily large N once the consistency of its charged strings is imposed?

sources.title: Global anomalies in 8d supergravity

evidence.text: Which global gauge and gravitational anomalies occur in eight-dimensional N = 1 supergravity, and when can dynamical 2-form fields or additional topological degrees of freedom cancel them?

sources.title: IIB string theory explored: Reflection 7-branes

evidence.text: How does duality holonomy alter the mass signs entering a type IIB KK anomaly sum?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: How much of the global SM gauge group is fixed by its known matter representations? The supplied representations permit four central quotients, although the global groups can differ in their nonperturbative observables and anomalies.

sources.title: Bosonisation cohomology: spin structure summation in every dimension

evidence.text: When can a unitary fermionic QFT gauge fermion parity, when can it sum over spin structures to become bosonic, and which gravitational anomalies make these conditions differ in arbitrary dimension?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Must singlet charges set the normalization of all massless abelian charges in the presence of nonabelian factors?

sources.title: An Analysis of Anomaly Cancellation for Theories in D=10

evidence.text: Does the familiar quartet exhaust the specified ten-dimensional local anomaly test, including products containing low-rank simple factors?

sources.title: Exploring the landscape of CHL strings on T$^{d}$

evidence.text: Which non-Abelian gauge groups of maximal left-moving rank d+8 occur in the CHL branch, at which moduli, and with what global topology? The systematic classification concentrates on d=1,2.

sources.title: The anomaly that was not meant IIB

evidence.text: Which anomaly tests are required when spacetime or brane topology can fluctuate?

sources.title: Line Operators in the Standard Model

evidence.text: How do the genuine electric, magnetic and dyonic line operators, theta-angle identifications and electromagnetic charges depend on the Standard Model's global gauge group G = [U(1) × SU(2) × SU(3)]/Γ, with Γ = 1, Z2, Z3 or Z6?

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Does the supersymmetric J obstruction persist after Wilson lines and bulk displacement reduce the BSB gauge group to SO(16)×USp(16)?

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: How does the Pati–Salam classification depend on taking an additional internal central quotient before identifying spacetime fermion parity?

sources.title: Four-dimensional $\mathbf{\mathcal{N}=4}$ SYM theory and the swampland

evidence.text: Which discrete ranks and actual gauge groups are allowed beyond the continuous rank ceiling? The paper also asks whether analogous massless-mode bounds hold with eight supercharges in dimensions six and below.

sources.title: Quantizing the Non-linear Graviton

evidence.text: What obstructs quantization of the twistor description of self-dual Einstein gravity, including its coupling to self-dual Yang–Mills, and can anomaly cancellation restore quantum integrability?

sources.title: Quantization of anomaly coefficients in 6D $\mathcal{N}=(1,0)$ supergravity

evidence.text: Which additional quantization conditions on 6D N=(1,0) supergravity anomaly coefficients follow from anomaly cancellation and string charge quantization, which require generalized completeness, and how does the global gauge group enter?

sources.title: Rational points in the 6d supergravity landscape and simple current extensions

evidence.text: Do five exotic anomaly-free T = 0 six-dimensional supergravity candidates satisfy stronger consistency tests from rational BPS-string worldsheets, and can their refined elliptic genera and global gauge groups be determined?

sources.title: Constraints on discrete symmetries from anomaly cancellation in compactified superstring theories

evidence.text: Do discrete symmetries arising in heterotic compactifications satisfy anomaly constraints analogous to those for remnants of spontaneously broken gauge symmetries, thereby restricting the light effective theory?

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture in anomalous quiver gauge theories

evidence.text: The cycle is a tractable family in which matter determines anomaly constraints and the number of original gauge factors can vary.

sources.title: *-wars episode 1: The Phantom anomaly

evidence.text: Which chiral noncommutative gauge theories are anomaly-free, and can the automatic disappearance of mixed gauge and flavor anomalies be interpreted as a Green–Schwarz mechanism generated by UV/IR mixing?

sources.title: Gauge group topology of 8D Chaudhuri-Hockney-Lykken vacua

evidence.text: How does an admissible root-lattice embedding determine the complete global gauge group of an eight-dimensional CHL vacuum, including Abelian factors, and why is its non-Abelian quotient compatible with the specified mixed one-form anomaly constraint?

sources.title: Implications of the weak gravity conjecture in anomalous quiver gauge theories

evidence.text: Can anomaly cancellation make surviving gauge repulsion too weak to satisfy conjectured gravitational and scalar-force bounds when a chiral theory contains many abelian gauge factors?

sources.title: The anomaly that was not meant IIB

evidence.text: Do the alternative anomaly-free realizations admit quantum-gravity completions, or do further consistency conditions place them in the Swampland?

sources.title: Anomalies in string theory with D-branes

evidence.text: When is the Type II worldsheet path integral globally well-defined with boundaries on D-branes, and what global interpretation of the brane A-field and bulk B-field cancels the fermionic anomaly?

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: How does a perturbative anomaly of a four-dimensional background flavor symmetry appear after compactification to three dimensions when a spacetime-dependent Wilson line is retained?

sources.title: Discrete anomalies in supergravity and consistency of string backgrounds

evidence.text: How do composite U(1) and discrete duality anomalies determine higher-derivative counterterms in ten- and eight-dimensional supergravity, and constrain consistent lower-dimensional string backgrounds?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Do anomaly cancellation and negative-definite tensor pairing imply an interacting fixed point? Two explicit gauge candidates remain unresolved here, while a vector-free isolated tensor is reported apparently inconsistent.

sources.title: Beyond Standard Models and Grand Unifications: Anomalies, Topological Terms, and Dynamical Constraints via Cobordisms

evidence.text: What changes in the Pati–Salam classification when the spacetime/internal fermion-parity quotient is taken without the additional internal quotient of Section 4.1?

How do θ periodicity and mixed CP/time-reversal–center anomalies constrain Yang–Mills vacua, domain walls, and thermal transitions, especially for SU(2) near θ=π?

What constraints remain beyond the local anomaly polynomial? The source lists global gauge-anomaly congruences from π6(G), then identifies anomalies of discrete global symmetries as a separate unresolved problem.

The entries specify anomaly data for conformal matter with different left and right endpoint groups. The background fields distinguish R-symmetry, gravitational, individual flavor, and mixed flavor contributions.
Can positivity or additional quantum consistency constrain abelian anomaly coefficients and primitive charges? The explicit coefficient 744S̃ must remain allowed by any compatible bound.
Can four-dimensional SU(2) theories that avoid the familiar anomaly nevertheless become anomalous when formulated using a spin-SU(2) structure without choosing a spin structure?

Which rational, family-dependent U(1)F charge assignments cancel all gauge and mixed gauge-gravity anomalies for SM fermions, optionally supplemented by up to three right-handed neutrinos, and how can these assignments be classified and enumerated?
Can a supergravity theory that passes bulk anomaly cancellation nevertheless fail because its required charged strings cannot support unitary worldsheet degrees of freedom?
Which geometric information verifies the probe-string assumptions and strengthens the supergravity bound on section-derived abelian gauge factors?

When do anomaly cancellation and compact U(1) leave finitely many rational hypercharge assignments in generalized SU(N) × SU(2) × U(1) models? The principal case has left-handed quarks and leptons in SU(2) triplets.
How should an anomaly classification be used differently for an ungauged matter system and a dynamical gauge theory?
How does the Z6 Standard Model group embed in SU(5), and how does its determinant constraint alter the characteristic-class input relative to independent unitary bundles?
When does the fermionic Z4 extension impose global anomaly matching, and when is it part of a dynamical gauge group whose anomaly must cancel?
Can a cubic-anomalous spectrum be completed with few heavy species while supporting a large vector-to-cutoff hierarchy? The first construction ignores gravity and allows noninteger charges.
Do analogous restrictions survive higher-dimensional cancellation mechanisms, and how strongly do the four-dimensional bounds constrain massive-vector models with heavy chiral anomaly cancellers?
This compact example tests the proposed string conditions in a U(1)×SU(2) theory with nine fundamental hypermultiplets. Its magnetic charges are nonnegative integer combinations of H and H−E.
Can another eight-dimensional construction with 16 supercharges realize E8+D7+A3, and could global anomalies explain why this algebra is excluded in toroidal heterotic compactification?
What restrictions follow from anomaly inflow onto strings coupled to four-dimensional tensor fields, or their dual axions, in minimally supersymmetric or nonsupersymmetric theories?

Do restrictions on non-simply-connected gauge groups G/Z in 8d string compactifications follow from quantum-gravity consistency, and how much of the apparent Swampland can a center-symmetry anomaly exclude?

Can one low-energy principle identify theories excluded by forced extra gauge factors, invalid geometric tunings and extra rational sections? The obstacle is that anomaly and string-charge data specify a homology class without visibly specifying the distinguished gauge-supporting curve.

What excludes the infinite anomaly-compatible su(N)⊕u(1) families, including N<13 descendants for which the specific su(13) local enhancement does not apply? The source leaves both the common obstruction and the role of quadratic charge dependence unresolved.

Can the anomaly-compatible T=0 su(2) spectrum with two half-hypermultiplets in the 4 representation be realized geometrically? The proposed realization requires a degree-five curve on P² with two distinct triple points.
Can the discrete-X mixed gauge-gravitational anomaly of the 15-Weyl-fermion SM or SU(5) GUT be canceled using topological or gapless hidden sectors, possibly together with sterile neutrinos?

Which constraints distinguish anomaly-free EFTs admitting quantum-gravity UV completions from the Swampland, how are these constraints connected, and how are they realized in string compactifications?
How does a perturbative anomaly of a four-dimensional background flavor symmetry appear after compactification to three dimensions when a spacetime-dependent Wilson line is retained?

Can an anomalous symmetry of a proposed parent obstruct lifting when that symmetry may emerge only after compactification? Can infrared-dual three-dimensional UV descriptions differ in liftability, or can supersymmetry central extensions supply an obstruction?
How do six-dimensional bulk anomaly coefficients determine the anomalies of strings charged under self-dual tensor fields?

How does an admissible root-lattice embedding determine the complete global gauge group of an eight-dimensional CHL vacuum, including Abelian factors, and why is its non-Abelian quotient compatible with the specified mixed one-form anomaly constraint?

Does the full discrete type IIB duality group have quantum anomalies obstructing its gauging, and can suitable topological couplings restore consistency with F-theory? Could alternative cancellation mechanisms define theories with the same massless supergravity fields?

Which symmetry and five-dimensional anomaly-inflow data specify the proposed deformation class of the four-dimensional Standard Model, with its internal group either ungauged or gauged and with continuous or discrete B−L-like symmetry?
What obstructs quantization of the twistor description of self-dual Einstein gravity, including its coupling to self-dual Yang–Mills, and can anomaly cancellation restore quantum integrability?

Can four-dimensional N=8 supergravity with continuous E7(7)(R) U-duality have a nonperturbative anomaly invisible to its anomaly polynomial, and does its actual field content realize or cancel that possibility?
What constraints on four-dimensional N=1 gauge-gravity EFTs follow from consistency of axionic EFT-string worldsheets, beyond bulk anomaly cancellation?
How does duality holonomy alter the mass signs entering a type IIB KK anomaly sum?
When can a circle-reduced anomaly be expressed through characteristic classes rather than a general nonlocal eta invariant?
How do vector and axial anomalies, their Noether currents and the local limit behave in an exponential infinite-derivative extension of QED, and what illustrative constraint follows from π⁰→γγ?
When can a unitary fermionic QFT gauge fermion parity, when can it sum over spin structures to become bosonic, and which gravitational anomalies make these conditions differ in arbitrary dimension?
How can constraints on characteristic classes define global variants of Abelian gauge theories, and how do these constraints change conserved charges and potential anomalies?

Do anomaly cancellation, gauge-enhancement singularities and higher-dimensional limits uniquely constrain the BPS protected couplings of eight-dimensional minimal supergravity with two vector multiplets, and exclude a gravitational contribution to the H-flux Bianchi identity?

Which chiral noncommutative gauge theories are anomaly-free, and can the automatic disappearance of mixed gauge and flavor anomalies be interpreted as a Green–Schwarz mechanism generated by UV/IR mixing?
How are gauge and gravitational anomalies computed and canceled in higher-dimensional effective theories, especially when orbifold singularities and discrete Wilson lines produce localized anomalies?
Can discrete instanton anomalies reveal nonperturbative consistency conditions on string vacua, and does classical spacetime CPT survive in available nonperturbative descriptions of M-theory?

Which gauge and mixed gravitational anomaly cancellation conditions remain physically necessary in supergravity with Fayet–Iliopoulos couplings after allowing finite local counterterms, and what does Green–Schwarz cancellation change?

How can several antisymmetric tensors jointly implement Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation in lower-dimensional open-string models whose residual anomaly polynomial does not admit the conventional single-tensor factorization, and what low-energy supergravity couplings realize this structure?

How can field theory explain linear-in-N wall tension and confining strings ending on walls? Can glued low-energy potentials determine wall tensions or BPS saturation, and does discrete anomaly matching exclude a chirally symmetric vacuum of supersymmetric gluodynamics?

destination.title: Observables, localization and information in quantum and gravitational theories
destination.question: How do dynamical geometry, gauge structure and information-theoretic assumptions affect observables, localization and access to quantum information?
destination.summary: A broad navigational family with separate questions about gravitational observables, quantum subsystems, observable algebras and information geometry. Different mechanisms and ordinary quantum-field-theory results remain distinct. Range definitions, proposed consistency extensions and laboratory probes retain alternate homes.

systems: Ordinary electromagnetic and anomalous quantum field theories
targets: Selection and possible modification of information metrics
assumptions: Numerical proximity and selection labels do not establish scientific membership.
A shared overview question does not establish fine-question equivalence.
Proposed failures of information-geometric assumptions require separate assessment from proposed probability-rule modifications.
conventions: Field-space distance, quantum-state distance, phase-space volume and position uncertainty remain different quantities.
Graph relations retain their exact source-parent scope.
includes: Ordinary and pre-Swampland work relevant to the questions
Conditional results, proposed mechanisms and explicit premise checks
Alternate access to adjacent range, consistency and measurement questions
excludes: A universal obstruction to locality from gauge invariance alone
A universal derivation of the Distance Conjecture from uncertainty
Established experimental departures from the Born rule
An inferred gravitational mechanism for the macroscopic magnetic-response proposal

sources.title: Observables, gravitational dressing, and obstructions to locality and subsystems

evidence.text: How does diffeomorphism invariance constrain gravitational dressing, screening, and the possibility of defining locality and quantum subsystems through commuting observable subalgebras?

sources.title: How is quantum information localized in gravity?

evidence.text: Can information be localized in gravitational subsystems despite gauge constraints and nonlocal dressings, and how much localized information can exterior fields or soft charges reveal?

sources.title: Spin-Spacetime Censorship

evidence.text: Can measurements of spin-dependent spacetime distinguish a distant observer's spin-measurement basis, and what censorship of gravitational spin readout is required to preserve relativistic causality?

sources.title: Quantum Information Theory of the Gravitational Anomaly

evidence.text: Does a pure gravitational anomaly obstruct spatial localization of quantum information, including local tensor factorization, reduced density matrices and lattice regulation?

sources.title: Physical limits on information metrics and quantum gravity as gravitized quantum theory

evidence.text: Do gravitational backreaction and limits on accessible boundary information undermine the assumptions fixing Fisher/Fubini–Study information geometry, motivating dynamical information metrics and a modified Born rule? Could intrinsic higher-order interference test this proposal?

sources.title: Quantum degrees of freedom of a region of spacetime

evidence.text: Can localized spatial regions be identified intrinsically as quantum subsystems selected by their dynamics, rather than assigning fundamental degrees of freedom to spacetime points in advance? The motivating problem is reconciling possible finite regional information with dynamical spacetime and the difficulties of a fixed short-distance cutoff.

sources.title: Observables, gravitational dressing, and obstructions to locality and subsystems

evidence.text: Explicit constructions use gravitational line dressings and angular averaging to obtain Coulomb dressings. Bilocal observables are examined through free-field mode expansion, normal ordering, and a Lorentz-invariant prescription for removing a redundant mass-shell divergence.

sources.title: How is quantum information localized in gravity?

evidence.text: Solves linearized Hamiltonian and diffeomorphism constraints using gravitational lines from point sources to a common origin. Additional exterior lines compensate total energy, boost, momentum, and angular-momentum contributions, leaving exterior initial data dependent only on their totals.

sources.title: Spin-Spacetime Censorship

evidence.text: Back-action is examined using the Dirac equation in curved spacetime and ADM quantization leading to a Wheeler–DeWitt equation. The latter argument uses conservation and discrete rotational symmetry rather than an explicit solution of the functional equation.

sources.title: Quantum Information Theory of the Gravitational Anomaly

evidence.text: Apply Virasoro commutators to boundary gluing (Ln − L̃−n)|B⟩ = 0; the central term yields (CL − CR)|B⟩ = 0.

sources.title: Physical limits on information metrics and quantum gravity as gravitized quantum theory

evidence.text: Analyze the assumptions attributed to Čencov's uniqueness theorem—permanent i.i.d. measurements and sufficient statistics—using recording-device backreaction and the transfer of statistics between observers. 'Local information objectivity' denotes agreement of their resulting inferences.

sources.title: Quantum degrees of freedom of a region of spacetime

evidence.text: Use the production of entanglement as an operational indicator of interaction, and interaction as a proposed indicator of spacetime coincidence. The approach is inspired by an Everett-style account in which measurements are unitary processes increasing correlations between subsystems.

sources.title: Linking numbers in local quantum field theory

evidence.text: When do commutators of intrinsic vector potentials encode linking numbers of spacelike separated loops, and what do nonzero commutators imply about the mass spectrum and existence of mutually local pointlike potentials?

sources.title: Diffeomorphism-invariant observables and their nonlocal algebra

evidence.text: How can diffeomorphism-invariant operators create a particle together with its gravitational field, reduce to ordinary field operators as gravity weakens, and what locality properties does their observable algebra possess?

sources.title: Measures of Distance in Quantum Mechanics

evidence.text: Can a distinguished quantum-state distance be selected by a principle analogous to the equivalence principle? The authors explore a stationary-action route to Fisher–Rao geometry and relative-entropy quasidistances, while acknowledging that a principle uniquely fixing quantum geometry remains missing.

sources.title: Algebras, regions, and observers.

evidence.text: Can the algebra accessible along an observer's timelike worldline replace region-based observable algebras when gravity makes regions fluctuate, and what does explicitly including an observer imply for de Sitter observables and entropy?

sources.title: Linking topological quantum field theory and nonperturbative quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can nonperturbative gravity with a finite spatial boundary yield Chern–Simons boundary observables and state spaces, and conditionally realize holography and an area bound on information?

sources.title: Topological susceptibility and information theory

evidence.text: Can the θ dependence of a nonabelian gauge-theory vacuum be described through quantum information, with topological susceptibility determining ground-state quantum Fisher information and an optimal θ estimator supplying an axion field and its low-energy relations?

sources.title: Quantum gravity without space-time singularities or horizons

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity retain spacetime, locality and strong causality while accommodating black-hole complementarity without physical singularities or horizons, by making the local metric scale an observer-dependent redundancy?

sources.title: The universal C*-algebra of the electromagnetic field

evidence.text: Can Maxwell equations, locality and covariance be encoded in a universal C*-algebra without fixing dynamics, with particular electromagnetic theories subsequently selected by states and representation kernels?

sources.title: Functional information geometry of Euclidean quantum fields

evidence.text: How do Fisher geometry, dual affine connections and relative entropy apply functionally to Euclidean quantum fields, and can one divergence functional generate both connected and one-particle irreducible correlation functions?

sources.title: A Theory of Backgrounds and Background Independence

evidence.text: Can backgrounds be described as inequivalent representations of an abstract observable algebra, and can adjoining observable intertwiners through gauging turn background labels into dynamical quantities? Superconductivity and perturbative gravity provide the principal examples.

sources.title: Local gauge invariant operator on isometry breaking background

evidence.text: Can spontaneous breaking of background isometries support local diffeomorphism-invariant operators, and when do accumulated coordinate fluctuations obstruct their reliable localization in regions such as black-hole islands?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity: A Fluctuating Point of View

evidence.text: What evidence supports asymptotically safe quantum gravity when dynamical metric fluctuations are distinguished from the background, and how are background independence, locality, matter stability and unitarity addressed?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Does gauge invariance itself prevent local observables and time evolution? Introducing coordinate fields in nondynamical flat geometry shows that the relevant obstruction is dynamical gravity, which makes causal separation fluctuate and requires physical clocks.

sources.title: Information metrics and possible limitations of local information objectivity in quantum gravity

evidence.text: Do quantum-gravitational backreaction and nonlocal observables undermine assumptions used to select the Fisher information metric, thereby permitting contextual information geometry and possible departures from a fixed Born rule for local observers?
